subject.title: [Feature]: UI 用量显示为 0，实际在消耗 token

question: Should OpenClaw expose DashScope/Qwen account usage in the bundled qwen plugin, and should the UI show quota windows, remaining balance, or both?
rationale: The code has the plugin seam, but the Alibaba/DashScope account-usage contract and display semantics are provider/product choices rather than a safe resolver-only bug fix.

options.title: Add bundled qwen usage hooks
options.body: Implement provider-owned auth extraction and usage snapshot normalization in the qwen plugin, then map the aliases into provider-usage routing.

options.title: Route to external plugin first
options.body: Leave core/provider usage unchanged until an external or experimental plugin proves Alibaba usage semantics and endpoint behavior.

recommendation.title: Add bundled qwen usage hooks
recommendation.body: Implement provider-owned auth extraction and usage snapshot normalization in the qwen plugin, then map the aliases into provider-usage routing.
